messages:
maya k: Drafted release notes for Monday deploy — need quick reviews: 1) known-issues language for embeddings streaming deprecation, 2) Generate SDK snippets (Go + Python) and function call example, 3) anchors in migration guide after heading moves. PR: docs/PR #3421.

sam chen: running link-checker now. will look for broken anchors and redirect fallout. which redirect list should I reference? :mag:

devin park: paste the Go snippet and I'll validate imports/constructor.

maya k: pasted initial Go snippet in PR:

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client := inference.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
    resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, inference.GenerateInput{
        Model: "redwood-kestrel-1",
        Prompt: "Summarize the following...",
    })
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Println("err:", err)
        return
    }
    fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

sam chen: two quick fixes — import path should be `github.com/redwood/inference-go` (we moved packages), and you need `os` in imports. I'll push a tiny patch.

devin park: also note new constructor and request names in the SDK. I'll prepare corrected snippet.

olivia r: for known-issues blurb avoid the word "breaking" — suggest: "Streaming embeddings are being consolidated into the new embed-stream API. Existing streaming endpoints will be deprecated; planned deprecation date: June 15. See migration guide for step-by-step changes." short + neutral.

maya k: ok. also should we call out a temporary client workaround? (flat:true)

devin park: flat:true is legacy. recommend: "If you must retain old streaming behavior, pin to model `redwood-embed-legacy` and set `stream_buffer=0`. Otherwise follow migration steps." I'll add a one-liner to known-issues.

nicole: release ops — are feature gates enabled for the embed-stream rollout? If yes, add opt-in instructions.

maya k: gates are on for canary orgs. note will read: "Feature is opt-in; org admins can enable via Console > Feature flags." nicole, confirm?

nicole: wording good. add link to console page and a deprecation date.

docs-bot: automated link-check for docs/PR #3421 — found 2 broken anchors: `/docs/migration/embed-2026#legacy-anchors` and `/docs/api/#embed_streaming`. Report: /tmp/link-check-1765000000.log

sam chen: ack. I'll fix anchors and add redirect rule in `_redirects`, then re-run link-check.

maya k: devin — can you paste the corrected Go snippet and a Python example for the function call pattern? hoping to merge EOD so QA can run smoke tests.

devin park: pushing corrected Go snippet now — fixes: import path, `os`, constructor `sdk.NewClient`, request struct `sdk.GenerateRequest`, and example of function call pattern.

devin park: corrected Go snippet:

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client := sdk.NewClient(ctx, os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
    resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, sdk.GenerateRequest{
        Model: "redwood-kestrel-1",
        Prompt: "Summarize the following...",
    })
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Println("error:", err)
        return
    }
    fmt.Println(resp.Output)
}
```

devin park: Python function-call snippet (inline):

```py
from redwood import Client

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
res = client.generate(
    model="redwood-kestrel-1",
    prompt="Summarize this text and return as JSON.",
    functions=[{"name": "summarize", "params": {"text": "string"}}],
    function_call={"name": "summarize"}
)
print(res.output)
```

olivia r: LGTM for wording. tiny nit: change "deprecation cutoff (June 15)" -> "planned deprecation date: June 15" — sounds more direct.

maya k: updated PR and release-notes draft, added Console link and migration guide anchor.

sam chen: re-run link-check — all clear except one external redirect to an old blog post. filing ticket to marketing for permanent redirect.

docs-bot: CI docs build preview available at https://docs-staging.redwood.com/preview/3421. Render shows `docs/migration/embed-2026.md` updated, snippets refreshed, release-notes appended.

maya k: merging now. thanks all :rocket:

sam chen: watching for post-merge regressions and will revert if necessary.

nicole: QA will run final smoke tomorrow morning per release timeline.

maya k: closing thread once QA confirms. tag me for anything post-merge. :white_check_mark:
